rca_of_the_issue: The production symptom was slow/504ing /api/leads under ~120k leads and 24 callers, cascading into 500/503 on polling/webhook endpoints. The inspected fix reduces caller default list scope to own book, keeps explicit all/search access, caches/coalesces counts/group_counts, fail-opens polled endpoints, and pins active_createdate_id only for the exact unscoped pipeline default query to avoid a blocking sort plan. Preview evidence confirms functional correctness and fast response times; production DB-capacity behavior still needs post-deploy monitoring.
